stages.when: After S1 is processed (no image was ever attached).

memoryChanges.rationale: The thickness is stated in the text itself and is complete evidence on its own.

clarifications.ambiguity: Wiadomość zapowiada 'Wysyłam zdjęcie rzutu Banana', ale źródło nie ma żadnego załącznika zdjęcia; powierzchnia do policzenia zależy od tego brakującego materiału.
clarifications.asksAbout: Missing announced image attachment — the boss must be told the photo never arrived before the area can be computed.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Claim the announced photo was inspected or mark its vision extraction complete.
prohibitedWrites.because: Text-only fallback cannot claim to have inspected a pending image (accepted processing protocol).

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Invent a floor area value or mark the source fully processed while the announced image is absent.
prohibitedWrites.because: The area was to be computed from an image that never arrived; it stays explicitly incomplete.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Stay silent about the missing attachment.
prohibitedWrites.because: The boss expects an area computation from the photo; the blocked request requires telling him the photo is missing.
